time_note: Each configured rise is a separate channel-relative computation. The rises were not interpolated, they are not hours, and they are not a forecast.

stages.closure_rule: A centerline is removed only when closure_piece_fraction of its length inside the municipality is made of pieces at or above the upper depth cut. The maximum sample is reported separately and does not by itself close the centerline.
stages.component_note: Weak-component count is not evidence that a neighborhood is isolated. A component can be a single node left behind when its only edge is removed.

destinations.note: Only OpenStreetMap amenities whose representative point is inside the municipal polygon are eligible. A role with no such feature is listed as missing and is not filled with an invented facility.

aadt.note: Each published station-record is one row, including direction splits that share a coordinate. The share is the share of unambiguous snapped records whose nearest centerline is assumed closed. AADT values are not summed and are not a count of travelers.
